newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse to buy Triad Systems.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse to buy Triad Systems.

text.p: Private investment group Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc and Austin, Texas-based Cooperative Computing Inc (CCI) said they have signed a definitive agreement to buy Triad Systems Corp in a transaction valued at $300 million.

Under the agreement, Hicks, Muse and CCI will start a $9.25 per share cash tender offer within five days for oustanding shares of Triad, representing a 68 percent premium over Wednesday's closing price.
Triad shareholders will also receive shares in an entity that will include Triad's real estate assets in California.
The companies said Triad's board of directors has unanimously approved the agreement.
Triad provides information systems to the automotive parts aftermarket, and retail hardware and lumber dealers.
Triad president and chief executive officer James Porter will serve as chairman of CCI.
The companies said they expect the transaction to be complete by the end of 1996. As part of the agreement, Hicks, Muse will invest $100 million in the combined Triad-CCI.
